title: Native Windows lab provisioning
summary: The native Windows lab adapter uses Windows OpenSSH and PowerShell, an interactive scheduled task for desktop screenshots and console checks, profile goldens that preserve live identities, and a lease-bound machine-settings recovery journal. Standard-user task control uses native Task Scheduler COM; protected SYSTEM receipts provide current-lease Windows feature evidence. SSH is key-only from any address. Human RDP is allowed over verified Tailscale self addresses or adapters, never the public internet; an SSH forward remains available for bootstrap. A private bounded SYSTEM probe verifies tailnet identity without selecting an administrator's Tailscale profile. Fresh setup teaches localhost SSH/RDP password custody and Start > Tailscale > Get Started with the existing account and expected-device approval. Provisioning privately backs up and disables only the verified vendor tray shortcut, refusing unexpected or renamed startup entries. SYSTEM probe receipts retain exact allowlisted failures and replace unknown errors with a fixed safe reason. Acceptance requires two separate cold boots with completed automatic standard-user logon, unchanged tailnet identity and startup key, private routes, and no tray autostart or intervening profile repair; command success alone does not prove persistence. Harness desktop and CLI sign-ins require separate visible-app and real-request proof before goldens. Provisioning and live restoration require separate machine receipts before readiness is claimed. A macOS controller installs a controllable Windows App before VM setup; local installation authentication and the private RDP password prompt are operator handoffs. Keep the lab on until active setup, sign-ins and QA finish, without countdowns or idle deallocation; verify and report final deallocation. Administrator staging cleanup failures remain fatal with named recovery and retain completed command diagnostics privately; they do not prove the primary command failed. Native vendor PowerShell installers decode raw UTF-8 response bytes consistently for binary and text media types. The guide names built-in Windows PowerShell 5.1 by its full executable path. Claude native installation completes its User PATH immediately, preserving existing entries and registry value kind; fresh logon discovery needs separate proof. Live per-user Windows packaged-app containers and Claude desktop data remain on the host through capture and reset; their app settings are not golden-restored. Claude CLI settings are captured and restored. Golden PATH snapshots retain raw values, registry kinds and absence; reset validates them before any mirror and verifies them after restoration. Older goldens without raw metadata require recapture. Console screen reads use the same interactive session as launch and input, opening CONOUT$ rather than redirected standard output; failures retain numeric Win32 and session context. Input resolves the uniquely titled visible host and validates user, session and foreground before sending keys, retaining the client PID for buffer reads and cleanup. Screenshot tasks request hidden windows so capture machinery does not obscure the application under review. Private robocopy logs retain copy failure diagnostics, which remain fatal. Canonical goldens also require the operator to review Claude Code’s one-time bypass warning personally; sign-in is separate and directly writing the acknowledgement is not proof. Reset removes profile links the golden lacks, keeping Windows' System-marked profile junctions, and refuses windows_reset_uv_state_left when uv-managed Python the golden lacks survives; failed console installs keep the last 40 lines of both output streams. Reset removes YokeQaMission scratch the running execution does not own. Before the mirror, reset stops processes running from the resettable profile, since robocopy cannot purge open files. The per-user data store service's open database (AppData/Local/Comms) stays live like packaged-app containers, and copy failures name robocopy's failing files in the refusal. The mirror excludes Windows' System-marked profile compatibility junctions, which /MIR would otherwise purge.
